display.title: T2: Machine Augments
display.subtitle: Tune your machines
description: §bAugments§r slot into Thermal machines and dynamos to retune them - more
speed, better efficiency, secondary-output boosts, wider tanks. The same
Pulverizer can be specced a dozen ways.
Craft a §bFlux Linkage Amplifier§r (a speed augment) to complete this beat,
then drop it into a machine to feel the difference.
§7Augments are how Thermal scales - the late tier is all about the right mix.
